aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer, defined as stage III/IV or stage IV
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Three genetic variants were associated with advanced (stage III/IV or IV) PCa risk: SEPP1 rs7579 (lower risk; P trend = .01), GPX1 rs17650792 (higher risk; P trend = .03), and GPX1 rs1800668 (lower risk; P trend = .005).
study_design: Prospective case-cohort study within the Netherlands Cohort Study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: This case-cohort study, which included 817 case subjects with advanced PCa and 1048 subcohort members, was analyzed with Cox regression models.
reason: The prospective case-cohort analysis exclusively evaluates advanced incident prostate cancer. The analytic participant total cannot be determined by summing cases and subcohort members because possible overlap is not stated.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Toenail selenium levels were inversely associated with advanced PCa risk, independently of common genetic variation in SEPP1 and GPX1.
estimate_classifications.reason: The selenium association explicitly concerns advanced prostate cancer, an aggressive incident endpoint; the abstract does not report an effect estimate with both confidence limits.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
